summary_en: 7,290,251 shares tendered (42.0% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Tender price ¥1,207/share (minimum acceptance threshold 4,165,800 shares met). Tender period 22 June–3 August 2026. Settlement from 10 August 2026. Terra Co. (100% owned by Luna Capital) to become parent and largest shareholder; Tommy Corporation to cease being largest shareholder.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Public Cash Tender Offer for Shares of Satudora Holdings Co., Ltd. by Terra Co., Ltd., and Changes to Parent Company and Principal Shareholders
translation_en_brief: On 3 August 2026, the public cash tender offer for Satudora Holdings shares by Terra Co., Ltd. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Luna Capital Fund No. 3) closed successfully. The tender price was ¥1,207 per share. A total of 7,290,251 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 4,165,800 shares, so the offer succeeded in full. All tendered shares will be acquired. Settlement commences 10 August 2026. Following settlement, Terra Co. will hold over 50% of voting rights and will become the parent company and largest shareholder. Luna Capital (Terra's 100% parent) will also qualify as parent company. Tommy Corporation, the previous largest shareholder, will cease to hold that status. The offer was made without prior capital relationship, personal tie, or transaction history between Satudora and the offeror.
